Summary
Senior Backend and Platform Engineer with 7+ years of experience building distributed, event-driven systems and
LLM-powered platforms at production scale. At Maersk, architected an AI documentation assistant (DevPal) serving 18+
engineering teams using hybrid RAG, Azure OpenAI, and MCP — and independently owns a high-traffic survey platform
built on Kafka, Temporal, and Node.js. Deep experience across the full delivery lifecycle: infra provisioning, schema design,
CI/CD, LLM observability, and production migrations.
Experience
Senior Software EngineerNov 2023 – Present
Maersk Bangalore, India
InsightsHub — Enterprise Survey & F eedback Platform
• Led end-to-end migration of a production survey platform from Java Spring Boot toNode.js (F astify), reducing
cold-start latency by∼45% and cutting infrastructure costs by∼30%.
• ProvisionedAzure PostgreSQL Flexible Servervia Terraform; owned CI/CD pipelines from build to
production deployment.
• Redesigned data schemas withPrisma ORMand executed zero-downtime large-scale production data migration
with automated validation and rollback safeguards.
• IntegratedKafkaconsumers to synchronize application and collaborator metadata with central systems, processing
10K+ events per day reliably.
• BuiltT emporalworkflows for survey scoring (NPS, CSAT, SUS), notifications, and collaboration updates —
replacing fragile cron jobs and reducing failure-related incidents by∼70%.
• ImplementedRediscaching layer supporting 1,000+ concurrent users with sub-50ms read latency, preventing DB
saturation under peak load.
• Created a dedicated orchestration service running Temporal workers, enabling horizontal scaling of async workloads
independently from the API layer.
• Set upPrometheus + Grafanadashboards tracking latency percentiles, error rates, and throughput; reduced
mean time to detect (MTTD) issues by∼50%.
F eature Suggestions Platform — Internal Product F eedback System
• Designed and delivered a cross-team feature suggestion system serving multiple product teams, enabling structured
product feedback at scale.
• Modeled hierarchical discussions usingself-referential Prisma relations, supporting arbitrarily nested comments
and replies withO(1) lookup per node.
• Implemented soft-delete strategies to preserve thread integrity and auditability across comment lifecycles.
• Built engagement features (likes, emoji reactions, voting) and email notification workflows for comments, replies,
and feature status transitions.
• Designed a feature lifecycle integrated withJira, enabling cross-team triage, scheduling, and release tracking from a
single interface.
DevPal (DevEx Agent) — Enterprise LLM Developer Platform, 18+ T eams
• Architected a multi-tenant AI documentation assistant inF astAPI + Azure OpenAIserving 18+ Maersk
engineering teams, indexing 1,640+ documents and 1,107 GitHub discussions with 3072-dimension embeddings.
• Designed ahybrid RAG pipeline: 3-pass LLM shuffle-and-tag ingestion strategy→Reciprocal Rank Fusion
(RRF) merging tag-based search, vector similarity, and PostgreSQL full-text search — with LLM re-ranking via
GPT-4.1-minibefore answer generation viaGPT-4.1.
• Eliminated OpenAI Agents SDK overhead by replacing the gpt-4.1 routing agent with a directgpt-4.1-mini
structured output call— reducing P50 response time from 33–40s to 22–27s (∼35% faster) and streaming first
token from 37s to 2–5s (10×improvement).
• Reduced GitHub Discussions initial embedding sync from55 minutes to∼5 minutesby replacing sequential
per-item API calls with batched embedding generation (100 texts/request).
• DesignedAI Ticket T riage service(TriageService): LLM completeness check→hybrid retrieval→
confidence-gated auto-reply (threshold: 0.70)→Hedwig on-call escalation; integrated with MS Teams via Power
Automate and GitHub Discussions webhooks; built bot-loop prevention via triage state machine.
• Built aplatform tool registryauto-generated from OpenAPI specs (MDP, MTTS, MRMP, MAC, Stargate
APIs) enabling the LLM to fetch live platform data — activity logs, service state, Kafka topics, team rosters —
without leaving the chat interface; user bearer token forwarded, no service principal needed.
• Exposed anMCP serverwith Azure AD OAuth, enabling DevPal to be consumed as a tool in VS Code,
Microsoft Teams, and Jira — adopted by 100+ engineers across the organization.
• Built a35-panel Grafana + Prometheusproduction observability stack; diagnosed and fixed 2 silent
instrumentation bugs (fallback counter never incrementing, latency histogram using wrong label) that had been
masking real metrics in prod.
Software Engineer Jul 2022 – Oct 2023
HealthEdge Technologies Bangalore, India
• Built a reusableReact + Reduxcomponent library published as internal NPM packages, reducing UI

control (RBAC).
• Implemented BPMN-based process workflows usingKogitoand managed schema versioning via Liquibase across

Software Developer Feb 2019 – May 2022
Tata Consultancy Services Hyderabad, India

Spring Boot.
• Wrote unit and integration tests achieving>80% code coverage on critical service modules.
• Automated operational workflows using shell scripts, reducing manual release effort by∼3 hours per deployment
cycle.
